name: @projexlight/connector-linear
summary: Linear connector: OAuth install + bidirectional issue / project sync, real-time webhooks. The lighter-weight alternative to connector-jira for tenants that run Linear; same composition pattern with sdk-workflow + sdk-projection. Optimized for Linear's GraphQL-only API.

hooks.name: registerBinding
hooks.description: Bind ProjexCloud entity → Linear issue type.

scenarios.title: Tenant installs Linear connector
scenarios.when_to_use: Admin grants OAuth scopes; we store refresh token + record the workspace.
scenarios.example_code:
import { installConnector } from '@projexlight/connector-linear';
const { install_id } = await installConnector({ tenant_id, auth_code });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Install row + vault-wrapped refresh token. Emits .install.created.v1.

scenarios.title: Workflow task creates a Linear issue
scenarios.when_to_use: Bind 'engineering-tasks' → Linear team's default issue type; new tasks appear in Linear automatically.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Issue created; Linear identifier stored on the task.

scenarios.title: Daily pull of project state
scenarios.when_to_use: Hydrate connector_linear.linear_project so the ProjexCloud roadmap dashboard reflects Linear.

scenarios.title: Linear webhook → ProjexCloud task transition
scenarios.when_to_use: Inbound webhook on issue update; we transition the linked ProjexCloud task to match.
scenarios.example_code:
import { handleWebhook } from '@projexlight/connector-linear';
await handleWebhook({ tenant_id, signature, body });

scenarios.title: Initial bulk-pull uses GraphQL pagination
scenarios.when_to_use: First-time install needs to backfill the cache; the scheduler does a paginated GraphQL walk to avoid rate-limit headaches.
scenarios.example_code: // Sync runner uses GraphQL `first: 50` + endCursor pagination automatically.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Cache hydrated; subsequent syncs only fetch deltas via Linear's syncTime filter.

compliance_posture.notes: Refresh tokens vault-wrapped. Linear's signing-secret verification mandatory on webhooks.
